title: Machine Unlearning in Generative AI: A Survey
measurement_description: The paper, in its survey of datasets for evaluating machine unlearning, discusses benchmarks like StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs which are used to measure stereotypical biases in language models across various categories, including religion.
findings: The paper is a survey and does not produce new findings on religion. It notes that existing benchmarks (StereoSet, CrowS-Pairs) are used to evaluate models for stereotypical biases related to religion, and it reviews unlearning techniques that can be applied to mitigate such biases.
